title: Accelerating Communication in Deep Learning Recommendation Model Training with Dual-Level Adaptive Lossy Compression
problem: All-to-all communication for collecting embedding data across multiple GPUs is a significant bottleneck in distributed DLRM training. This communication overhead severely limits training efficiency and scalability.
motivation: DLRM is widely adopted in industry applications requiring multi-GPU training, and communication optimization is critical for improving training throughput.
method: The approach applies error-bounded lossy compression to embedding data informed by analysis of embedding characteristics. A dual-level adaptive strategy adjusts compression error bounds at table-wise and iteration-wise granularities to balance compression benefits with model accuracy. The compressor is optimized for PyTorch tensors on GPUs to minimize compression overhead.
key_novelty: Dual-level adaptive error-bound adjustment strategy (table-wise and iteration-wise) for lossy compression of DLRM embedding communication.
contributions: Error-bounded lossy compression algorithm tailored to DLRM embedding data characteristics
Dual-level adaptive error-bound adjustment spanning table-wise and iteration-wise aspects
GPU-optimized PyTorch implementation minimizing compression overhead
Achieves 1.38× training speedup with minimal accuracy impact
primary_theme: lossy compression for communication optimization in DLRM training
